statement: For U = F or U = Fp, and 0 ≤ k ≤ 1, the largest feasible scale on this ray is dU(k) := max{d ≥ 0 : (2d, kd) ∈ HU} = min 0≤t≤1 U(t) 2 + kt . (11.7) Consequently, w(k) ≤ 1 dU(k) = max 0≤t≤1 2 + kt U(t) . (11.8) A maximizing parameter is the leftmost t ∈ [0, 1] for which (2 + kt)U′ +(t) ≥ kU(t), (11.9) or t = 1 if no such point exists.
